items.title: Cowboys owner Jerry Jones said he is still confident in head coach Brian Schottenheimer.
items.text: Jones said he is not considering a head coaching change. This came just minutes after the Cowboys’ catastrophic meltdown against the Eagles on Thanksgiving. Dallas gave up 22 points in the fourth quarter and lost on a last-second field goal. Schottenheimer stripped DC Christian Parker of play-calling duties two weeks ago. The Cowboys gave up 79 points to Cam Ward and Joe Milton in senior defensive assistant Mike Pettine’s first two games calling plays on defense. Schottenheimer has had no issues getting points on the board, but his Cowboys have routinely found spectacular ways to snatch defeat

items.title: Elijah Moore caught 3-of-5 targets for 57 yards in the Eagles’ Week 12 win over the Cowboys.
items.text: Elijah Moore catching passes from Joe Milton makes a lot of sense on August 19, but is a little more surprising on Thanksgiving. Still, the 26-year-old was able to put together a solid day and helped set up the game-winning field goal with a couple of catches on the final drive. It’s hard to imagine Moore is fantasy relevant in Week 13 against the Cardinals, but he and Milton did appear to be on the same page. - Christopher Crawford

items.title: Makai Lemon caught 5-of-6 targets for 51 yards and a touchdown in the Eagles’ Week 12 win over the Cowboys.
items.text: Lemon was vastly improved from his disappointing one-catch against the Steelers the previous week. He brought in his first touchdown since Week 7 — also against the Cowboys — and it got the Eagles to within two points with just over two minutes left. The Eagles weren’t able to convert the two-point conversion, but still came up with the improbable victory. Lemon will try and build on this effort against the Cardinals in Week 13. - Christopher Crawford

items.title: Will Shipley rushed 10 times for 46 yards in the Eagles’ Week 12 loss to the Cowboys.
items.text: Shipley took over after Saquon Barkley suffered a stinger, and while the Eagles were mostly in pass-mode because they fall behind 31-0, Shipley did a decent job in his limited touches. If Barkley can’t go in Week 13 against the Cardinals, Shipley is an interesting fill-in for that contest. - Christopher Crawford

items.title: KaVontae Turpin caught 1-of-3 targets for a 31-yard touchdown while adding a 10-yard rush in the Cowboys’ Week 12 win over the Eagles.
items.text: Turpin did most of the work on a dump-off from Dak Prescott. The 30-year-old remains an impact player on special teams, but despite the score, he offers very little fantasy upside for the remainder of the season. Or next season. - Christopher Crawford

items.title: George Pickens caught five-of-nine targets for 67 yards in the Cowboys’ Week 12 loss to the Eagles.
items.text: Pickens dropped what would have likely been a touchdown from Dak Prescott early in the game. He also had a catch that would have resulted in a first down, but after being hit hard, he went nine yards backwards and wasn’t given forward progress. After impressing the previous two weeks, this was a disappointing effort. He’ll get a chance to rebound in Week 13 against the Seahawks in a Monday Night Football showdown. - Christopher Crawford

items.title: CeeDee Lamb caught 7-of-11 targets for 134 yards in the Cowboys’ Week 12 loss to the Eagles.
items.text: Lamb also committed two pass interference penalties; one that wiped a touchdown off the board, although the Cowboys would end up scoring a few plays later. The 27-year-old was still able to fantasy day while going over 100 yards for the sixth time in the 2026 season. Lamb will remain a WR1 even with a tough matchup coming in Week 13 against the Seahawks. - Christopher Crawford

items.title: DeVonta Smith caught 11-of-14 targets for 200 yards and two touchdowns in the Eagles’ Week 12 win over the Cowboys.
items.text: Smith was able to bring down an impressive 50-yard touchdown throw from Joe Milton to get the Eagles within two scores. He did the same on a 45-yarder a quarter later in what was easily his best game of the 2026 season. The hamstring issue that has limited Smith as of late did not appear to be an issue Thursday, and he appeared to have some quality chemistry with Milton. Smith is a WR2 on paper for a showdown in Week 13 against the Cardinals, but this effort shows the WR1 upside is palpable. - Christopher Crawford

items.title: Javonte Williams rushed 28 times for 101 yards and two touchdowns in the Cowboys’ Week 12 loss to the Eagles while adding three receptions for 22 yards and a receiving score.
items.text: Williams ran in for two scores in the first half, and then was able to just get into the end zone on a connection with Dak Prescott for his third score of the first half. The second-half was quiet for the tailback, but the damage was done while reaching 15 total scores on the season. Williams will be in the RB1 conversation, even with the sledding likely significantly tougher against the Seahawks in Week 13. - Christopher Crawford

items.title: Joe Milton completed 21of-31 passes for 331 yards with three touchdowns and an interception in the Eagles’ 39-38, Week 12 win over the Cowboys while adding 15 yards and a touchdown on the ground.
items.text: Milton certainly isn’t boring. He even showed off some impressive touch at times, but the most impressive throw was a bomb that went 58 yards in the air for a score to DaVonta Smith. He nearly matched that dart with another 45-yarder to Smith in the third quarter as he lived up to the Bazooka Joe nickname. He even showed off some scrambling ability, particularly on a 15-yard scrambling into the end zone in the middle of the fourth quarter. The only real mistake was a forced throw with the Eagles down eight on the next possession, but he followed that up with a brilliant 24-yard throwing score
